posts.title: A Megadungeon Thought Experiment
posts.description: The megadungeon has been my favorite premise for adventure campaigns for a few years now. At the cost of some upfront prep, you can create an enclosed and toyetic space for players to visit, experiment, return, and see change over the course of play. posts.title: Extending Blackjack as a Resolution Engine
posts.description: Last week I presented a framework for what I called a Simple Heroic Adventure Game . The core concepts I want to explore were creating a heroic archetype from a simple matrix, a blackjack-based resolution engine inspired by my Hellbenders work last year, and a basic set of heroic principles of play. posts.description: KEEPER LINK I wanted to share a tool with the blogging community that I made for my various long-form campaigns.
